description: Belarusian → Russian settlement names. OSM carries `addr:city` in Belarusian («Гродна», «Слонім») while the product speaks Russian, so the column the card shows would read in the wrong language. Read by `seed fetch` (db/seed/cli.py) and applied to every row's town on the way into the dataset.
why_a_list_and_not_a_geocoder: Reverse geocoding answers this too, but it needs a network pass per value and earns a rate limit for it. The names below are the ones a reader can vouch for; a village left untranslated is untidy, a village translated wrongly is a wrong fact on a card.
scope: Covers the cities, the district centres and the well-known towns. A value not listed keeps the spelling the source gave it — deliberately, and visibly: the seed report shows how many towns stayed untranslated.
